seed_policy: preserve legacy masked text; structural errors exclude; similarity warnings remain provisional; explicit focal solutions require repair

lexical_diagnostic.inheritance: original snapshot lexical floors/gaps retained; no dense calipers applied to lexical scores

matcher.objective: maximum cardinality, then minimum declared integer cost, then edge-rank sum and deterministic sorted graph order

canonical_grid_note: MISSING_COVARIATES for unresolved dense relevance, model-token length, first-public dates and numeric purity; NOT_ASSESSED is not 0.70
audit_sampling: five lowest SHA256 seed IDs in each warning/hard-error/repair/unflagged group; source-only and pre-matching
packet_audit: all measured lexical banks; fixed first-k ID-sorted matching slots; cyclic balanced assignment and packet order
